Maria Chen: Quick heads-up — external pen test team (RapidAudit) booked for Wed 9AM PT. This thread to coordinate preflight scan triage, RBAC delta, KMS proxy, and retest windows.
Akshay Patel: ack. Can we confirm which services are in scope again? includes: API gateway, inference runtime, telemetry ingest?
Maria Chen: scope: hosted API + dedicated control plane + telemetry export. Excludes customer data stores. Will share assessor list and manifest in the intake doc.
Selene Li: For RBAC changes we should prefer ephemeral roles for the assessor during the window. Suggest :shortlived: AWS STS with 2hr sessions.
Ben O'Neill: Agree. Also need auditstream sampling set to 100% for the window and preserve logs for 90 days. Ops oncall can we patch retention? @oncall
oncall: I can toggle retention and snapshot once we have the exact window. Will need the start/end timestamps.
Maria Chen: Window: Wed 09:00–15:00 PT. We want a 30min warmup before giving access. Plan: 08:30 snapshot + role issue at 09:00.
Akshay Patel: KMS question: assessors will need to decrypt artifact proofs stored in S3. Do we want to grant them kms:Decrypt on the key, or proxy decryption through a shortlived service account?
Selene Li: Prefer proxy pattern — avoid direct key grants. We can spin up an ephemeral decryption service in the assessor VPC peered network, it holds a short-lived grant. That reduces key exposure.
Ben O'Neill: Implementation detail: we can create a KMS grant for the ephemeral service principal and set GrantConstraints: EncryptionContextSubset with the assessor id. Example grant command:
```bash
aws kms create-grant --key-id alias/pen-test-key --grantee-principal arn:aws:iam::111122223333:role/ephemeral-decryptor --operations Decrypt,GenerateDataKey --constraints EncryptionContextSubset={"assessor":"rapid-audit-123"}
```
Maria Chen: Nice. Also: add an audit log marker at the start and end of each session so we can prove scope of decrypt ops.
Akshay Patel: Question on RBAC delta: which permissions are we comfortable elevating for the assessor role? I propose read-only cluster admin for inference nodes and read-only S3 list/get for evidence buckets. No write perms.
Selene Li: +1. Blocklist: no IAM change, no keystore writes, no KMS CreateGrant or rekey. Those must be reserved for Red Team lead.
Ben O'Neill: I'll prepare a minimal IAM policy snippet. Rough:
```json
{
  "Version": "2012-10-17",
  "Statement": [
    {"Effect":"Allow","Action":["s3:GetObject","s3:ListBucket"],"Resource":["arn:aws:s3:::evidence-*"]},
    {"Effect":"Allow","Action":["ec2:DescribeInstances","ssm:GetParameter"],"Resource":"*"}
  ]
}
```
Maria Chen: Good. Next: evidence packaging — we should publish a presigned manifest and a read-only URL set for the assessors. No direct DB queries.
Akshay Patel: For audit logging, ops will create an 'assessment' log stream tag with assessor id so we can filter. Also enable full request/response capture for 2 endpoints: /v1/generate and /v1/kvcache.
Selene Li: That might capture PII. Make sure we mask tokens and customer prompt content in the captured payloads. Use existing redaction lambda before archival.
Ben O'Neill: On retest: if they report high/critical findings, we should offer two retest windows: quick patch (48–72h) for trivial fixes or scheduled retest during next maintenance window. We need to decide SLA for retest booking now.
Maria Chen: Let's commit to: critical fixes -> emergency retest slot within 72h subject to ops availability; non-critical -> scheduled retest in next monthly PT cycle. Document that in intake.
Akshay Patel: Who's owning remediation tracking? I can maintain a vuln board in the security tracker and tag owners. Need a point-of-contact from infra and runtime.
Selene Li: I'll own runtime fixes. Ben takes infra/S3/KMS. Maria will be escalation and assessor liaison.
pen-test-bot: Reminder: please upload assessor list, allowed CIDR blocks, and intake manifest to /security/pen-tests/6209991111/ before EOD Monday.
Maria Chen: Will do. Final checklist for ops: snapshot retention set, auditstream sampling 100%, ephemeral decryptor role built, IAM policy drafted, presigned URLs created. Call to sync 10:30 Tuesday for dry-run.
oncall: Noted. I'll stand by for the snapshot command and will confirm when done.
Ben O'Neill: I'll drop the IAM policy + KMS grant template in the intake doc and tag you all.
Akshay Patel: Thanks — appreciate keeping this lean. We should add small smoke tests post-access: run 3 queries against /v1/generate and verify latency & masking.
Selene Li: Adding smoke test steps to the dry-run agenda.
Maria Chen: Perfect. If anyone sees additional blockers post-dry-run flag them here. :thumbsup:
